fields.label: Anthropic API Key
fields.description: Your Anthropic Console API key (starts with sk-ant-...). Never shared with the frontend.

fields.label: Google AI (Gemini) API Key
fields.description: Your Gemini API key from Google AI Studio. Gemini has a free usage tier, unlike the Anthropic API.

fields.label: Default Model
fields.description: Used when a new chat is started without explicitly picking a model.

fields.label: System Prompt
fields.description: Instructions given to the assistant at the start of every conversation. Leave blank for a plain assistant.
